note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and web for Pike County MO parcels. The county assessor (Vanguard Appraisals) GIS viewer at maps.camavision.com/pikemo is a web client with no public ArcGIS REST endpoint found (probe of maps.camavision.com/arcgis/rest/services returned 404).
